0022600004.text: Both the Timberwolves and the Heat are opening their 2026-27 seasons, with Minnesota on the road. Minnesota will be without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out following Achilles surgery, and Ayo Dosunmu, who is day-to-day with rest and a game-time decision. Miami's Bam Adebayo (groin), Dru Smith (calf strain) and Giannis Antetokounmpo (rest) are all listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, and the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 season series 2-0, including a 122-94 win in Minneapolis on January 6, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Timberwolves a 50% chance to win.
